reason: Static agent-loop audit found that multiple tool calls emitted in one assistant turn were executed sequentially even when later calls semantically depended on observations from earlier calls. Dependent multi-tool tasks must require an observation boundary rather than allow same-turn lookahead/guessing.

correction.rule: Only the first tool call emitted in an assistant turn may execute. Additional calls in the same turn receive parallel_tool_call_requires_observation and cannot advance task state.
correction.rationale: A later dependent tool call must be generated only after the prior tool observation is visible to the agent.
correction.scope: all B1 conditions identically; no condition-specific behavior

unchanged: 23 corrected task IDs and required route sets
required_next_steps: complete the corrected task-contract freeze and Phase-A revalidation
pass the full B1 protocol suite including causality regression tests
create B1 episode sources only after that protocol-success checkpoint
accept only a 552-unique-key aggregate from post-amendment sources
provenance_note: This amendment was identified by static control-flow audit before any accepted complete B1 aggregate. No condition-level B1 result was used to introduce the causality rule.
